title: Normal Sinus Rhythm
description: Practice describing ventricular rate, rhythm, atrial activity, intervals, and the ST/T segments in a structured ECG review.
learning_objectives: Describe rhythm regularity and P-wave relationships
Review the PR interval, QRS complex, axis, and ST/T segments

axis.evidence: QRS complexes are predominantly positive in leads I and aVF

p_waves.relationship: One consistent P wave precedes each QRS complex

st_t.description: No significant ST-segment or T-wave abnormality

teaching_notes: Canonical educational pattern. Add a validated ECG tracing before using this case for image-based learner interpretation.

title: Sinus Bradycardia
description: Practice a systematic ECG review with particular attention to ventricular rate, rhythm regularity, and atrial activity.
learning_objectives: Estimate and describe the ventricular rate
Assess rhythm regularity and P-wave relationships
Review axis, intervals, QRS width, and ST/T segments

axis.evidence: QRS complexes are predominantly positive in leads I and aVF

p_waves.relationship: One consistent P wave precedes each QRS complex

st_t.description: No significant ST-segment or T-wave abnormality

teaching_notes: Canonical educational pattern with a slow sinus rate. Add a validated ECG tracing before using this case for image-based learner interpretation.

title: Sinus Tachycardia
description: Practice distinguishing rate observations from rhythm and waveform observations during a structured ECG review.

Review axis, intervals, QRS width, and ST/T segments

axis.evidence: QRS complexes are predominantly positive in leads I and aVF

st_t.description: No significant ST-segment or T-wave abnormality

teaching_notes: Canonical educational pattern with a fast sinus rate. Add a validated ECG tracing before using this case for image-based learner interpretation.
